headline: Carhenge / Shandoka goes before Telluride Board of Education Monthly Meeting on Tuesday, August 25
blurb: The August 25 Board of Education meeting carries real weight. The most consequential item is a flood-related budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — the board will discuss and then vote on adjusting the district's spending plan to account for flood damage, a reminder that the canyon's geography extracts its own costs.
